author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert (DSConv Expert A) + mean↔LSE pooling + BiGRU(160), scalar gate + post-norm — tri-seed (seed=7)
abstract: Tri-seed replication of the DSConv-based dual-expert (dilations=[1,2,4,8,16]): Expert A=DSConv+mean↔LSE(τ=0.25,len-norm), Expert B=BiGRU(160); scalar-gated fusion + post-LN. This run uses BASE_SEED=7.
